metadata.description: Mini subset of the EXP16 selection concepts (25 per body, spread over O2r_m50) plus the small full-run result summaries that method.py build_outputs() reads.

verdict.label: selection data, outcomes previously unsealed: robustness evidence, not confirmation

P1.rule: psp(NOVCHURN_exc) >= 0.70 psp(NOVCHURN_raw), same sample, R2, COH1517 AND OLDHO

power_frame_n.plain_language: At n = 800 (S_A, T3 = half the pooled raw estimate) joint power (OPEN_home R3 & R5 & NOVCHURN_raw R3) = 0.07; at n = 2500 it is 0.26. With T2 (COH1517 raw) it is 0.31 / 0.75. Pessimistic n-mix (S_B, T3): 0.03 / 0.06. The fallback O2r_m30 outcome set is not simulated here (out of scope); analytic n for 0.8 marginal power per index is in n_for_80pct_marginal.
